title: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual Volume 2A, Instruction Set Reference A-L
section: IDIV, printed pages 3-440 through 3-442; PDF pages 542 through 544
retrieval: Primary official PDF read successfully through web tool; 652-page document. Direct PowerShell download returned HTTP access denial; no local full-document identity or hash is claimed.
observations: Sixteen-bit signed division uses DX:AX and produces AX quotient and DX remainder, truncating toward zero.
Zero divisor and an out-of-range signed quotient raise divide error.
Arithmetic condition flags are unspecified after IDIV; projection fault comparisons therefore use captured pre-IDIV carry and do not claim post-IDIV arithmetic-flag behavior.
limit: Architecture reference supporting the flag/fault comparison policy. Does not establish actual historical CPU, BIOS, exception handling, timing or DOS gameplay behavior. No manual implementation copied into recovered source.
